title: Mesherra Object v1
description: A passive resource (calendar, document, meeting agreement, etc.) owned by a single principal. The owner's stack holds canonical state; every observer reads through a scoped Promotion. Authoritative source: mesherra/src/mesherra/models/primitives.py (Object). This JSON Schema is the runtime-validation and cross-language mirror.

version.description: Schema version of this object record.

object_id.description: Stable Object identifier (UUID-style). Assigned at create; never changes across the Object's lifetime.

owner.description: Principal that canonically owns this Object. Mutations are owner-only.

home_layer.description: Default visibility layer when no active Promotion grants a viewer access.

mutability.description: static: snapshot at promotion time. live: continuously updated reference (Slice 2).

schema_ref.description: Schema ID of the state payload (e.g., meshycal.scheduling/calendar-v1).

state.description: The Object's content. Structure governed by schema_ref.

object_version.description: Monotonic per-Object version. Starts at 1; bumps on every mutation.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 (hex, lowercase) of canonical_json(state). Computed by the model; mismatched caller-supplied values are rejected at construction.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of last mutation. Equals created_at at create.
